The canonical source for the manhua episode: the Chinese, the line-parallel English, and the panel layout. publish-manhua.mjs upserts this into `stories` (content / english_content / panels / presentation='manhua'); src/manhuaEpisodes.test.js validates the Chinese against the HSK 1 snapshot and the layout against the reader's own rules. Edit here, never in the database.
title: 第一话 · 我是新学生
english_summary: You climb the lantern-lit steps to the Hanzi Dojo, meet 小雨, and kneel at a writing table for your first lesson. Something small and white is watching from behind a lantern.
_content_comment: One beat per line, 'NAME：text' with a fullwidth colon, exactly as every other authored format stores it — the shared engine (useStoryReaderCore) tokenizes this and the manhua reader only decides where each line is drawn. Beat indices are 0-based and are what panels[].bubbles[].beat refers to; INSERTING A LINE MEANS RE-INDEXING THE PANELS.
content:
我来学校了。
这是学校吗？
小雨：你好！你是新学生吗？
你：是，我是新学生。
你：我来学写字。
小雨：太好了！
小雨：我叫小雨。你叫什么名字？
小雨：来吧！我们去那边。
学校很大。
小雨：这是我们的学校。
林老师：我是林老师。
林老师：请坐。
林老师：你会写汉字吗？
你：会一点儿。
你：我写不好。
林老师：很好。
林老师：没关系。
林老师：现在我们学写字。
小雨：这个字很漂亮。
那是什么？
小雨：那是小白。
小雨：小白喜欢看我们写字。
小白也想学汉字吗？
english_content:
I've come to the school.
Is this the school?
Hello! Are you the new student?
Yes, I'm the new student.
I came to learn to write.
Great!
I'm called Xiao Yu. What's your name?
Come on! Let's go over there.
The school is big.
This is our school.
I am Teacher Lin.
Please sit.
Can you write Chinese characters?
A little.
I don't write well.
Very good.
It doesn't matter.
Now we'll learn to write.
That character is beautiful.
What is that?
That's Xiao Bai.
Xiao Bai likes watching us write.
Does Xiao Bai want to learn characters too?
_vocabulary_comment: Every word in this episode is HSK 1 (data/hsk1-vocab-snapshot.json). There are no reach words at all. The only tokens outside the word list are the three proper names, which are curated in src/characterNames.js so the reader gives them the 'Name' popup with a reading instead of translating them character by character. 小白 rather than the canon's 白: the reader's name matcher only takes names of two characters or more (matchName), so a one-character name would be read as the ordinary word 白 'white' — and 小白 is what you would actually call him.

meta.hook: Something small and white followed you through the gate.
meta._continues_comment: What the closing plate promises next, and the level it is written at. `level` is a level NUMBER in this story's own system — the reader prints it with getLevelLabel, so the plate says 'HSK 2' without anything hardcoding that string, and a Japanese or Russian season would print its own system's label. Omit the whole block for an episode that ends a season.

panels._cast_comment: A cast entry with a `display` gets a printed speaker label above its bubble; without one the bubble is bare, which is how a manhua panel works — the drawing says who is talking. The speaker is still announced to screen readers either way.

panels.alt: Dusk. A young traveller with a scroll on their back stands small at the foot of a long stone stair, looking up at a lantern-hung dojo gate above a misty village.
Low angle: the huge tiled dojo gateway towers over the traveller, who is a small dark shape at the bottom of the frame.
Close-up: 小雨 leans grinning into the left of the frame, an ink brush through her hair and a red ribbon at one side; the right half of the panel is quiet empty wash.
小雨 in a lantern-lit courtyard, one hand at her chest as she introduces herself; the traveller's shoulder is in dark foreground at the left edge.
小雨 walks ahead along a covered lantern-lit walkway, turning back over her shoulder to beckon the traveller on.
The empty calligraphy hall: two rows of low writing tables, each with blank paper and a resting brush, under hanging lanterns.
A letterbox panel: a tall calligraphy master stands in a lit doorway, face half in shadow, a brush held loosely at his side.
林老师 kneels behind a low writing table, looking straight at the reader and opening one hand toward the empty cushion in the foreground.

panels._ratio_comment: The generation came back 16:9; cropped to 4:3 here because this panel carries two lines and a letterbox has no room for the second. The brush is centred, so the crop only loses outer shadow.
panels.alt: Extreme close-up of the master's hand and brush beginning a single bold stroke of wet ink on blank paper.
panels._bubbles_comment: The teacher's encouragement now follows the learner's answer in one uninterrupted reading sequence.

panels.alt: 小雨 leans over the writing table with both hands flat on it, eyes shining, watching the master's brush.
Almost darkness. A tiny white ink spirit with a single black brushstroke on its forehead peers out from behind a paper lantern, trailing a thread of ink-smoke.
The traveller walks in through the dojo gate, seen from behind; far back down the steps the small white spirit drifts after them.
